answer: Per-identity voyage escrow: each agent posts a bond priced at the marginal cost one fake identity imposes, then completes a verified route before its vote counts. Each bridge hop between operator domains issues one non-transferable arrival token, rate-limited per key so hops cannot be parallelized. The voyage ends at a haven checkpoint where an honest quorum signs the arrival. Escrow burns on route reuse, so a sybil fleet pays bond plus real sequential travel per puppet: capital and wall-clock cannot be reset, forging n votes costs n full fares, honest users pay once.
